verdict.rationale: Community evidence confirms Notion's database functionality is used for project/issue tracking across teams and enterprises (notion-comm-1, notion-comm-4, notion-comm-12), implying support for structured fields like status/priority/owner, but no first-party documentation in the pack explicitly describes these property types or team-assignment fields, and one comment notes limits when used as a project/issue tracker (notion-comm-6). missing for 10: explicit docs on status/priority property types, dedicated team/owner assignment fields, and independent case studies confirming initiative tracking at scale.
